symbols.name: prime source length
symbols.meaning: The odd prime length chosen for axis $i$.
symbols.quote: A prime source length is an odd prime $s_i$ chosen just below the padded length of its axis.

symbols.name: padded length
symbols.meaning: The power-of-two padded length of axis $i$.
symbols.quote: Here $t_i$ is a power of two, the padded length of axis $i$, and $s_i$ lies just below it.

symbols.name: source product
symbols.meaning: The product of the prime source lengths, $S=\prod_i s_i$.
symbols.quote: Write $S=\prod_i s_i$ for the product of the source lengths and $T=\prod_i t_i$ for the padded box.

symbols.name: padded box size
symbols.meaning: The product of the padded lengths, $T=\prod_i t_i$.
symbols.quote: Write $S=\prod_i s_i$ for the product of the source lengths and $T=\prod_i t_i$ for the padded box.

symbols.name: number of axes
symbols.meaning: The number of axes, which is also the number of primes chosen.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes and $\eta$ a fixed gap with $0<\eta<1/4$.

symbols.name: gap parameter
symbols.meaning: A fixed number with $0<\eta<1/4$ that sets the width of the prime windows.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes and $\eta$ a fixed gap with $0<\eta<1/4$.

relations.quote: The lengths $s_i$ are the moduli of the [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md) that turns one cyclic convolution of length $S$ into a multidimensional one over the $s_i$.
The primes are sized for [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md), since each ratio $t_i/s_i$ must leave separation for it.
